messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] overage costs
parts:
Jeroen,

If you have a starter plan, you will not be billed for overages. After 100 hours your account will be suspended, preventing your applications from loading. If you want, you can upgrade to the basic plan which has more hours, or you can wait until next month, where your account will automatically be un-suspended.

Hope that helps,
-Andy
